patterns.note: Each project section employs a unique, asymmetrical grid or collage layout for its visual assets, rather than a uniform template, making each showcase distinct.
A very large, expressive display serif font is used exclusively for the personal introduction, creating a strong brand statement distinct from the clean sans-serif used for all other content.
The site's base palette is a high-contrast monochrome of black, white, and subtle grays, with vibrant accent colors introduced only within specific project imagery.
The client logo strip features a continuous, looping horizontal scroll animation, dynamically presenting a list of past clients without user interaction.
Project sections are clearly delineated by generous vertical spacing and a consistent structure of title, year, category label, description, and custom visual layouts.

technique_notes: The client logo section uses CSS keyframes to create a continuous, looping horizontal scroll animation, presenting a dynamic list of past clients without requiring user interaction.

Each portfolio entry utilizes a bespoke, asymmetrical grid or collage layout for its visual assets, combining full-width images with smaller, grouped elements to create a unique and tailored presentation for every project.

A very large, distinct display font is used for the primary introductory statement, establishing a strong personal brand, while a clean sans-serif handles all other content, supported by small, uppercase labels for categorization.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, expressive display heading (~4-5x body) for the intro, with clear hierarchy for project titles (~2x body) and small, uppercase labels (~0.7x body).
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (minimal rounding on some image corners, but predominantly sharp edges).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical spacing between sections and within project descriptions, creating a clean, uncrowded feel).

standout: This site distinguishes itself by foregoing a traditional hero section for a direct, personal text introduction, immediately followed by a dynamic client logo scroller. Its most unique feature is the highly customized, asymmetrical layout for each portfolio project, making every case study feel like a bespoke design piece rather than a templated entry.
